title: LAUNCH. LOG. SEND.
speech: Alright. Let's get you back in the game. Here's how to launch Brutal Legend VR... and get us the logs when something goes wrong.

beats.text: Alright. Let's get you back in the game.

title: INSTALL. PREPARE. PLAY.
speech: Run the installer. It puts the launcher on your PC. Open it, choose your Steam game, and hit Prepare once. Connect through Link or Air Link... then hit Play VR.

beats.text: Run the installer. It puts the launcher on your PC.

Connect through Link or Air Link... then hit Play VR.

title: TURN ON THE DETAILS
speech: Something going wrong? Open VR settings. Turn on Detailed troubleshooting logs, hit Save... and try again.

beats.text: Something going wrong? Open VR settings.
Turn on Detailed troubleshooting logs, hit Save... and try again.

title: REPRODUCE THE PROBLEM
speech: Reproduce the problem once. Keep the exact error message. Here, the headset isn't connected.

beats.text: Reproduce the problem once. Keep the exact error message.
Here, the headset isn't connected.

title: ONE CLICK. ONE ZIP.
speech: Back in Play and setup, choose Export support ZIP. Pick a folder... and save the whole file.

beats.text: Back in Play and setup, choose Export support ZIP.
Pick a folder... and save the whole file.

title: THE EVIDENCE, TOGETHER
speech: That ZIP holds your available logs, settings, and system details. Take a look before sharing it. Nothing sends itself.

beats.text: That ZIP holds your available logs, settings, and system details.
Take a look before sharing it. Nothing sends itself.

title: SEND THE ZIP WITH THE STORY
speech: Attach the ZIP to your support thread. Tell us your headset, what you clicked... and what went wrong.

beats.text: Attach the ZIP to your support thread.
Tell us your headset, what you clicked... and what went wrong.

title: CAN'T OPEN THE LAUNCHER?
speech: Launcher won't open? Run Collect Support Logs from the install folder. Installer failing? Open the logs folder... and grab installer latest dot log.

beats.text: Launcher won't open? Run Collect Support Logs from the install folder.

title: FROM YOUR ZIP TO A DIAGNOSIS
speech: We check the report, find the failing step... and use those logs to work out what happened.

title: BACK TO THE METAL
speech: Reproduce. Export. Send. Turn detailed logging off afterward... and let's get you rocking.
